# Rename news event. A news event, not a country event: a new country name is world news, every
# player sees the new name on the map anyway, and major = yes shows it to all of them at once.
# ROOT is the renamed country: the event is fired in its scope (rn_rename_event_fire), so it is
# the receiver. FROM is the sender, the acting player, which is another country when an overlord
# renames a subject (in-game test 2026-10-14: the news named the UK for a renamed Raj).
# rn_prev_n (old name) and rn_rename_variant are on ROOT.
add_namespace = rn_rename

	id = rn_rename.1
	title = { trigger = { ROOT = { check_variable = { rn_prev_n_len > 0 } } } text = rn_rename.1.t }
	title = { text = rn_rename.1.t_new }
	desc = { trigger = { ROOT = { check_variable = { rn_rename_variant = 1 } } } text = rn_rename.1.d1 }
	desc = { trigger = { ROOT = { check_variable = { rn_rename_variant = 2 } } } text = rn_rename.1.d2 }
	desc = { trigger = { ROOT = { check_variable = { rn_rename_variant = 3 } } } text = rn_rename.1.d3 }
	desc = { text = rn_rename.1.d4 }
	picture = GFX_news_event_generic_read_write
	major = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = { name = rn_rename.1.a }
}
